name: personal-assistant
description: Desk - a personal AI assistant with its own computer: durable bots, per-bot memory, a shared skill library, routines, and a human approval boundary.

scripts.desktop:icons: npx --prefix desktop electron desktop/render-icons.cjs && node desktop/make-icons.mjs
